title: Financial Provisions in the Constitution of India

contacts.name: Rakshit Madan Bagde
contacts.affiliation: Late. Mansaramji Padole Arts College, Ganeshpur,Bhandara.

descriptions: The scope of the Indian Constitution is very vast. It includes economic, social, political, as well as all aspects necessary to run the country. The Indian Constitution promises social, economic and political justice to all its citizens. Freedom of expression, belief, and worship, equality of opportunity, and dignity of the person. The brotherhood which ensures the unity of the nation is divided into three parts. One is the preamble, the second is the fundamental rights and the third is through the directive principles. Through the related article, an overview of the financial provisions of our Indian constitution has been given.
